account.name: EcoCare Home Comfort
account.industry: HVAC / Home Comfort (heating, cooling, air conditioning)

match_confirmation.by_conversion_action: Submit Form Lead EHC (EHC = EcoCare Home Comfort)
match_confirmation.by_campaign_name: PPC Guru - PMAX - AC (AC = air conditioning / HVAC)

queries.monthly_trend: SELECT segments.year, segments.month, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.conversions, metrics.all_conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY segments.year, segments.month
queries.conversion_actions: SELECT conversion_action.name, conversion_action.type, conversion_action.category, conversion_action.status FROM conversion_action WHERE conversion_action.status='ENABLED'
queries.genuine_leads_by_category: SELECT segments.month, segments.conversion_action_category, metrics.conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY segments.month
queries.campaigns: SELECT campaign.name, campaign.advertising_channel_type, campaign.bidding_strategy_type, campaign.status FROM campaign WHERE campaign.status='ENABLED'

detected_launch: PPC Guru management begins ~November 2025 (first spend Nov 2025, $407 / 42 clicks / 0 conversions = launch ramp). First complete lead-producing month = December 2025. PPC-Guru-branded conversion actions and the 'PPC Guru - PMAX - AC' campaign confirm PPC Guru rebuilt/launched the account.
notes: Method B launch story: baseline = first complete quarter under management (Q1 2026, Jan-Mar); 'now' = most recent complete quarter (Q2 2026, Apr-Jun). July 2026 is a partial quarter (Q3) and is EXCLUDED from the headline comparison.

Genuine leads = PHONE_CALL_LEAD + SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM only. No GBP local-action, outbound-click, or page-view categories appear in this account's category data, so raw metrics.conversions equals genuine leads for Dec 2025 - Jun 2026.

July 2026 anomaly: clicks jump to 3,367 (vs ~95-267 prior months) with 59 form submissions in a single month, driven by a Performance Max traffic/asset expansion. Because July is a partial quarter AND the form volume looks unusual versus history, July is excluded from the case study and flagged for review before any future reporting.
An offline QUALIFIED_LEAD import ('offline (Upload)') is configured for closed-loop tracking of booked/installed jobs but shows no recorded conversions in the queried window.
Campaign type is Performance Max with Maximize Conversions bidding (single active campaign).
